    <!-- GUIDE GEEK -->
    <script defer>
        const script = document.createElement('script');
        script.src = 'https://embed.guidegeek.com/embed.js';

        script.dataset.disableChatToggle = true;
        script.dataset.company = 'florida-keys';
        document.body.appendChild(script);

        document.querySelector('.mn-guidegeek-button').addEventListener('click', () => {
            document.querySelector('.mn-guidegeek-button').style.display = 'none';
        });
        document.addEventListener('GuideGeekChatRegistered', (e) => {
            const chat = e.detail.chat;

            // Set intro text from GuideGeek theme
            document.querySelector('.mn-guidegeek-speech-bubble p').innerHTML = chat.command('theme', 'introText');

            const STORAGE_KEY = 'guidegeek_last_shown_timestamp';
            // 14 days * 24 hours * 60 mins * 60 secs * 1000 ms
            const TWO_WEEKS_MS = 14 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000;

            const now = Date.now();
            const lastShown = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY);

            // Check if never visited OR if visited more than 2 weeks ago
            if (!lastShown || (now - lastShown > TWO_WEEKS_MS)) {

                // Show the bubble
                document.querySelector('.mn-guidegeek-speech-bubble').style.display = 'block';

                // Update the timestamp to right now
                localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, now);
            }

            chat.on('WindowClosed', (data) => {
                document.querySelector('.mn-guidegeek-button').style.display = '';
            });

        });
    </script>
